why: The complex quadratic Fatou conjecture itself appears still open with no direct proof, disproof, or bound found; however, recent work (Dudko-Lyubich, and a Dec 2025 arXiv note on MLC and renormalization theory) proves MLC at Feigenbaum points, a case of the related MLC conjecture that is known to imply density of hyperbolicity for the quadratic family, and I could not confidently determine whether this counts as settling a case of the Fatou conjecture itself or is a distinct implying conjecture.
